newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open firmer but seen lacking impetus.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open firmer but seen lacking impetus.

text.p: The UK's FTSE 100 index opened modestly firmer on Monday but was seen lacking enough incentive to make significant progress ahead of an onslaught of major company earnings later in the week.

"We have a lot of results later this week," said one senior dealer. "In typical Monday fashion I expect we'll lack direction and volumes will be quite low." The FTSE 100 was up 6.0 points to 4,857.5 by 0740 GMT.
U.S. blue chips had limped slightly lower on Friday and failed to provide direction for London stocks. The Dow fell 3.49 points to close at 8,113.44.
